SELECT p.id,p.supplier_org_id,p.effective_name AS name,p.days,p.gateway,p.effective_description AS description,p.name_origin,p.description_origin,p.version,c.name AS source_name
                FROM product_listing p JOIN supplier_connection c ON c.id=p.connection_id LEFT JOIN product_search s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE p.status=$9
                AND (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR p.id>$1)
                AND ($2=$10 OR (CASE WHEN s.product_version=p.version AND s.display_version=p.display_version THEN s.document ELSE lower(p.effective_name||$11||p.name||$12||p.code||$13||COALESCE(p.gateway,$14)) END)
    LIKE $3 ESCAPE $15)
                AND (CAST($4 AS integer) IS NULL OR p.days=$4)
                AND ($5=$16 OR p.gateway=$5)
                AND ((CAST($6 AS date) IS NULL AND CAST($7 AS date) IS NULL) OR EXISTS(
                    SELECT $17 FROM departure d WHERE d.product_id=p.id AND d.status=$18
                    AND (CAST($6 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date>=$6)
                    AND (CAST($7 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date<=$7)))
                ORDER BY p.id LIMIT $8

SELECT c.id FROM public.supplier_connection c
          JOIN public.distribution_grant g
            ON g.connection_id=c.id AND g.supplier_org_id=c.supplier_org_id
          JOIN public.organization o ON o.id=c.supplier_org_id
          WHERE c.active AND o.active AND g.active AND g.buyer_org_id=public.warehouse_org_id()
            AND g.valid_from<=now() AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>now())
            AND (SELECT public.warehouse_has_org(public.warehouse_org_id()))

(SELECT org=public.warehouse_org_id() AND EXISTS (
          SELECT $2 FROM public.membership m JOIN public.warehouse_user u ON u.id=m.user_id
          JOIN public.organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id
          WHERE m.user_id=public.warehouse_user_id() AND m.organization_id=org
            AND m.active AND u.active AND o.active
        ))

SELECT o.id AS offer_id,o.version AS offer_version,o.name AS offer_name,o.service_description,o.inventory_pool_id,o.supplier_org_id,o.connection_id,d.id AS departure_id,
        d.external_id,d.company_id,d.depart_date,d.code AS departure_code,p.effective_name AS product_name,p.name_origin AS product_name_origin,c.name AS source_name,d.version AS departure_version,p.version AS product_version,p.display_version,
        d.sales_paused,d.local_booking_deadline,
        c.connector_type,COALESCE(c.capabilities->>$3,$1) AS business_timezone,
        g.id AS grant_id,g.version AS grant_version,g.expires_at AS grant_expires_at
        FROM offer o JOIN departure d ON d.id=o.departure_id JOIN product_listing p ON p.id=d.product_id
        JOIN supplier_connection c ON c.id=o.connection_id
        JOIN distribution_grant g ON g.connection_id=o.connection_id AND g.buyer_org_id=warehouse_org_id()
        WHERE o.id=$2 AND o.active AND d.status=$4 AND p.status=$5 AND c.active AND warehouse_live_grant(g.id)

(SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT $2 FROM public.distribution_grant g WHERE g.id=grant_uuid AND g.active
            AND g.valid_from<=now() AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>now())
            AND (
              (g.supplier_org_id=public.warehouse_org_id()
                AND (SELECT public.warehouse_has_org(public.warehouse_org_id())))
              OR (g.buyer_org_id=public.warehouse_org_id()
                AND g.connection_id IN (SELECT public.warehouse_buyer_connections()))
            )
        ))

INSERT INTO quote_snapshot(id,buyer_org_id,actor_id,offer_id,grant_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,body,fresh_until) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,CAST($8 AS jsonb),$9) ON CONFLICT(buyer_org_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

SELECT d.id,d.product_id,d.supplier_org_id,d.code,d.depart_date,d.return_date,
          d.version,d.observed_at,d.sales_paused,d.local_booking_deadline,p.effective_name AS name,p.name_origin,o.id AS offer_id,c.name AS source_name,
          COALESCE(c.capabilities->>$7,$8) AS business_timezone,
          CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.total-i.sold-i.held-i.blocked
            WHEN d.availability_expires_at>now() THEN d.available_seats END AS available,
          CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN $9 WHEN d.availability_expires_at<=now() THEN $10
            WHEN d.available_seats IS NULL THEN $11 ELSE $12 END AS availability_status
          FROM departure d JOIN product_listing p ON p.id=d.product_id
          JOIN supplier_connection c ON c.id=d.connection_id
          LEFT JOIN inventory_pool i ON i.departure_id=d.id
          LEFT JOIN offer o ON o.departure_id=d.id AND o.code=$13 AND o.active
          WHERE d.status=$14 AND p.status=$15
            AND (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR d.product_id=$1)
            AND (CAST($2 AS uuid) IS NULL OR d.id=$2)
            AND (CAST($3 AS uuid) IS NULL OR d.id>$3)
            AND (CAST($4 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date>=$4)
            AND (CAST($5 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date<=$5)
          ORDER BY d.id LIMIT $6

WITH applicable AS MATERIALIZED (
              SELECT * FROM warehouse_applicable_prices($1,$2)
            )
            SELECT p.*, boundary.next_start, grade.grade_id, grade.grade_version
            FROM (SELECT min(valid_from) AS next_start FROM applicable WHERE valid_from>now()) boundary
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT * FROM applicable WHERE valid_from<=now() AND valid_until>now()
              ORDER BY CASE layer WHEN $3 THEN $4 WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE $7 END,id LIMIT $8
            ) p ON $9
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT b.id AS grade_id,b.version AS grade_version FROM buyer_price_grade b
              JOIN offer o ON o.connection_id=b.connection_id
              WHERE o.id=$1 AND b.buyer_org_id=$2
            ) grade ON $10

SELECT d.id,d.product_id,d.code,d.depart_date,d.return_date,d.company_id,d.observed_at,
            d.sales_paused,d.local_booking_deadline,COALESCE(c.capabilities->>$6,$7) AS business_timezone,
            CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL THEN d.availability_expires_at ELSE $8 END AS availability_expires_at,
            CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.total-i.sold-i.held-i.blocked WHEN d.availability_expires_at>now() THEN d.available_seats ELSE $9 END AS available_seats,
            CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN $10 WHEN d.availability_expires_at<=now() THEN $11 WHEN d.available_seats IS NULL THEN $12 ELSE $13 END AS availability_status,
            i.id AS inventory_pool_id,i.version AS inventory_version
            FROM departure d JOIN supplier_product p ON p.id=d.product_id
            JOIN supplier_connection c ON c.id=d.connection_id
            LEFT JOIN inventory_pool i ON i.departure_id=d.id
            WHERE (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR d.product_id=$1) AND (CAST($2 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date>=$2)
            AND (CAST($3 AS date) IS NULL OR d.depart_date<=$3) AND p.status=$14 AND d.status=$15 AND NOT d.source_quarantined
            ORDER BY d.depart_date,d.id LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
SELECT * FROM quote_snapshot WHERE (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR id=$1) AND (CAST($2 AS text) IS NULL OR idempotency_key=$2)

(SELECT public.warehouse_has_org(public.warehouse_org_id()) AND EXISTS (
          SELECT $2 FROM public.membership WHERE user_id=public.warehouse_user_id()
            AND organization_id=public.warehouse_org_id() AND active AND roles && allowed
        ))
SELECT warehouse_has_role(CAST($1 AS text[]))
SELECT total-sold-held-blocked AS available FROM inventory_pool WHERE id=$1
SELECT public.warehouse_begin_context($1,$2)

SELECT s.user_id, (CAST($1 AS uuid) IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT $3 FROM membership m JOIN organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id
                  WHERE m.user_id=s.user_id AND m.organization_id=$1 AND m.active AND o.active
                )) AS organization_allowed
                FROM auth_session s JOIN warehouse_user u ON u.id=s.user_id
                WHERE s.token_hash=$2 AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>now() AND u.active
